courses.name: Economics (Common Course)
courses.description: Shared core course for micro/macroeconomics assignments

questions.questionText: What happens to the demand curve of a normal good when consumer income increases?
questions.explanation: For normal goods, an increase in consumer income increases purchasing power, shifting the demand curve to the right.

questions.questionText: Which market structure is characterized by a single seller, high barriers to entry, and no close substitutes?
questions.explanation: A pure monopoly exists when one firm produces all output in a market with prohibitive entry barriers.

questions.questionText: Which of the following are components of aggregate demand in macroeconomics?
questions.explanation: Aggregate demand is represented by AD = C + I + G + (X - M).

questions.questionText: Fiscal policy involves government decisions regarding taxation and public spending.
questions.explanation: Fiscal policy is set by government via budget appropriations and tax adjustments.

questions.questionText: State the economic term for the cost of the next best alternative given up when making a choice.
questions.explanation: Opportunity cost quantifies the forgone benefit of the second-best option.
